gotchas: Password rule on the form: 8 to 16 alphanumeric characters with a digit, a lowercase and an uppercase letter. Create the login with maxLength 16 and noSymbols.
Title and the three date-of-birth parts (DD, MM as month names, YYYY) are custom comboboxes: click the combobox, then the visible [role=option] by exact text.
Email must be typed twice (contact-email and contact-confirm-email).

Mobile is three parts: a country autocomplete input[aria-label="Country/RegionMobile"] (default Singapore +65; type the country and click its [class*=autocomplete] li), a MobileAreaCode box, and the national number. An E.164 phone value is marked invalid in the number box, so it needs the split phone tokens.
Country of residence is an autocomplete: type 'United States' and click the li that does not say 'Minor' (it is 'United States Of America'). That enables the State/Province autocomplete.
#btnContinue stays disabled until every required field is valid, including the T&C checkbox.
